main_text.head: De caufis æqualitatis perpetuæ dierum & noctium in Sphæra recta & inæqualitatis in obliqua.
main_text.p: CAVSA Æqualitatis dierum & noctium perpetuæ in sphæra recta, est æqualis ascensio duorum quorumlibet hemicycliorum zodiaci & æquatoris confinium. Cum quouis enim zodiaci hemicyclio undecunq; inchoato, hemicyclium æquatoris uicinum exoritur æqualiter. Ergo in quocunq; eclipticæ puncto Sol uerfetur, perpetuo fex signorum Solem consequentium, quatuor oblique, duo recte, & cum omnibus illis 180 gradus æquinoctialis emergunt, cumq; descensiones ascensionibus æquales sint, totidem cum ijsdem decumbunt.

At contra inæqualitatis dierum & noctium in sphæra obliqua causa contraria est, nimirum duorum quorumlibet hemicycliorum zodiaci & æquatoris ascensio inæqualis, duobus exceptis, quæ punctis designantur ac definiuntur æquinoctialibus. In sphæra obliqua enim cum duob. tantum hemicyclijs zodiaci, his punctis inclusis, boreo scili-cet

page.notes: Faint show-through from the reverse page is not transcribed. Ornamental marks after headings and the final line are read as printed. The last line runs into the signature area; "cet" is read as the catchword. Some words in the second paragraph ("hemicycliorum", "duob.") are read with some doubt.
